sim._doc: The simulation clock: ticks a second, game minutes a real second, the steps a tick at the fast speeds, the hour a map opens at, and how fast buildings grow on queued lots. grow_on_reach_m: the next building grows on the free lot nearest the last one grown when one lies this near, else on one drawn at random (Roadcraft world/growth/zoning.ts GROW_ON_REACH, 70 m). body_cache_mb: the memory the buildings' bodies made from their seeds may keep (sim/buildings/b40/body_cache.h), shared by every reader; past it the least recently asked are made again when asked.

economy._doc: Money: the funds a map opens with, the share of a road's price given back on demolition, and from what height a road is charged as fill or as a structure on piers.

world._doc: The map's grids: the size of a terrain tile and the spacing of the height and water samples.

render._doc: What the renderer draws and how far: occluder buildings, where roads, props and each building level end, the street lamps' and headlamps' lights, the level-of-detail error, and the per-frame budgets of chunk rebuilds, mesh commits and uploads. ground_cache_mb: the memory the chunks' ground (roads, lots and ecosystem the trees and the cover plant on: render/trees/ground_kept.h) may keep for the city as it stands; past it the least recently read are gathered again. rooms_cache_mb: the memory the rooms behind the buildings' panes may hold, each counted with the body it keeps alive, and as much again for the bodies cut open at a floor (render/buildings/building_bodies.h).

terrain._doc: The landscape: height limits, embankment slope and run, how far the ground sits under a road, the rough and hard ground of the relief, and the river's depth, freeboard, floor and shore.

land._doc: The land a new map is generated with (sim/terrain/terrain_gen.cpp), in metres unless the name says otherwise. A plain map lies flat at plain_m. Hills: hills_base_m plus hills_amp_m of fractal noise over hills_scale_m (hills_octaves), with bumps_amp_m over bumps_scale_m (bumps_octaves); towards the canal they flatten into a valley valley_width_m wide, keeping 1 - open_share of their height and rising at least to valley_floor_m. Ranges: past edge_start of the half map the land climbs over edge_ramp by range_base_m plus range_amp_m of noise over range_scale_m (range_octaves). The canal runs canal_from_edge_m in from the north edge, river_radius_m wide a side; its bed is cut river_strength_m x river_carve x river_bed_depth under the land, the banks are the lowest of bank_probes points round it, its water stands water_fill of the way from bank to bed (at least water_margin_m under the bank, at least river_min_depth_m deep), smoothed over smooth_passes passes and falling at least river_min_fall a metre downstream. Lakes: in each lake_grid_m square a basin with chance lake_chance, kept lake_edge_max of the half map from the edges and lake_river_gap_m from the canal; it sinks basin_depth_m over basin_radius_m (to basin_reach of it), its rim wobbling by basin_wobble with noise over basin_noise_m (offset basin_noise_step a metre of the basin's place); the water finds the basin's bottom in at most descend_steps steps and floods every sample within flood_slack_m under the rim, standing as the canal's does. The values are the source game's terrainGen.ts (B4 of log/review.md re-sources them).

road._doc: The road tool: least length, U-turn openings, snapping to ends, grid and angles, merging and overlap limits, the freehand stroke, and the lane and pavement widths of the road variants.

flow._doc: Automatic junction control (sim/traffic/flow_warrants.h), vehicles an hour: a signal by the MUTCD 2009 Warrant 1 (section 4C.02, Table 4C-1, 100% column, one lane each way): Condition A signal_major on the major street's two approaches and signal_minor on the busier minor approach, Condition B signal_major_b and signal_minor_b; a Stop on every leg by section 2B.07 paragraph 04 C, stop_major on the major approaches and stop_minor on the minor ones. The game's own: step_down, the share of its volumes below which a control steps down; trend_window, seconds of the measure's trend (its time constant a third) and the least time between two changes; look_every_s, seconds between two looks at the junctions.

grade._doc: The road heights solver: the weights of the ground, the authored height, ramps, decks and tunnels, and the clearances and deck depths of each structure.

history._doc: Undo and redo: the most steps and megabytes the history keeps.

roundabout._doc: The roundabout tool (sim/commands/roundabout.cpp, the lab's editor/roundabout.ts): a ring of radius_min_m to radius_max_m round its centre on vacant ground, ring_nodes nodes, every other one an entry with a two-way approach of approach_m; refused over water by water_samples samples round its ring (kept water_clear_m over it).

edit._doc: Road edits: the shortest piece a split leaves, what counts as a straight street, and the spacing of duplicated roads.

inspect._doc: The Inspector: the length a vehicle takes in a lane, and the least angle between the legs of a junction. radius_m: how far round a click the inspector looks for a building or a road.

build._doc: The Build tools: the grid and module, the primitives' sizes, the limits of a body's sides, storeys, openings, projections, roofs and parts, and the snapping to roads and buildings. The body editor (sim/commands/body_*.cpp): a free relief steps by free_relief_step_m; a wing is wing_share of the block, a shaped block's inset shaped_inset_share; a block clicked in lands within click_in_m of another; stairs and bands: the shortest leg shortest_leg_m, the lowest flight lowest_flight_m and step lowest_step_m, a flight flight_width_m wide, a band band_width_m wide, nothing thinner than thinnest_m; a model placed against a road runs along its side when within along_side_cos of its depth, flush within flush_pad_m. handle_*: where the body editor's handles stand, by eye: a wall's arrows side_out_m out, the move and turn corner_out_m off the corners, the scale scale_out_m, the storeys above_roof_m over the roof, the floor's handles off_floor_m up, a lift lift_out_m out, a relief relief_out_m out.

structure._doc: Bridges, viaducts, walls and tunnels: span and cable spacing, towers, piers and their caps, parapets, abutments and tunnel portals. backfill_in_m and backfill_over_m: the backfill behind a cutting's wall stops this far inside the dug band, where the ground comes back, and lies this far over the ground it covers (design values of the road walls, render/roads/road_walls.cpp).

zone._doc: The zone brush: the side offset of a zoned lot and the spacing of its samples.

strike._doc: The bomb: the force steps of its strip, the pressure that brings a frame down, the storey a fall counts, and the size and reach of the scars a blast leaves. Street furniture is looked for within furniture_reach_m of the blow; within splinter_share of the knock-out range a pole goes to splinters with chance splinter_chance. The player's utility poles (the reference game's explodeAt): those within the fireball radius fall, close in (splinter_share of it) to splinters with chance splinter_chance, else snapped with chance snap_chance, else whole; a felled pole pulls over a neighbour its span reaches within pull_share fireball radii with chance pull_chance, and a span left with one pole standing hangs from it as a torn wire.

lot._doc: The lot editor (sim/commands/lot_commands.cpp): a pointer within corner_take_m of a corner takes it, within side_reach_m of a side reaches it. angle_look_m: how far round a point a drawn lot looks for the street it squares to. The delete stroke (lot_erase) is read every erase_step_m along its way, shorter than any lot's front (lotTool.ts STROKE_STEP), and takes the buildings standing within erase_reach_m of a point whose ground blocks cover it (lotTool.ts eraseUnder, 80 m). A lot grown is a corner lot when a street's paving lies, within corner_margin_m, corner_beyond_m past one of its sides at corner_near and corner_far of its depth (zoning.ts cornerOf, STREET_MARGIN).

shoot._doc: A round (sim/commands/shoot_*.cpp): a two-wheeler's rider is thrown from rider_back_m behind it with rider_push of the round's push, the wound drawn rider_hit_m over its ground.

junction._doc: The road geometry's junctions (sim/roads/junction.cpp): the longest a mouth retreats from its node (max_retreat); a width step from one arm into the other over taper_min_step m tapers over max(taper_min, step x taper_slope) m (transition.ts transitionRunFor); a dead end's bulb only on roads of at most bulb_half_max m a side and bulb_len_min m long. A kerb return: at least kerb_radius_min m and fillet_share of the narrower width, a width step under taper_angle_deg degrees off straight tapered (its step at least taper_min_step m), a corner of acute_deg degrees or more filleted while its miter stays within corner_miter of the wider arm, a bevel set back bevel_pad times the half widths. The lab (world/junction/): a road reconciles its two mouths against its length (trim.ts clampSegmentTrims): it keeps min(drivable_reserve_m, reserve_cap of its length) for driving (approach.ts MIN_DRIVABLE_RESERVE: a 14.4 m link and two approach zones of 1.2 m setback, a 3 m zebra and a 0.64 m stop bar), never under least_ribbon_m (scalar.ts MIN_RIBBON), and scales both mouths down to what is left; a mouth corner inside a non-adjacent arm's carriageway grows that mouth by slab_bump_scale and slab_bump_add_m at most slab_attempts times, never past slab_bump_cap widest arms (build.ts SLAB_BUMP_CAP, findSlabViolations with GEO_EPS slab_margin_m); two arms bent under transition_bend_deg carry one road on (build.ts MAX_CONTINUOUS_BEND), over the larger of the taper run and the bend run (twice the carriageway as radius, its run capped at transition_radius_cap radii, the turn at transition_turn_max_deg), or seam_run_m where only the structure changes (SEAM_RUN), their kerb lines offsets of a cubic axis sampled every transition_step_m, at least transition_samples_min samples (transition.ts SAMPLE_STEP); a node whose arms all leave on one side is capped by a circle of the widest carriageway (polygon.ts nodeCap, CAP_STEPS points); a turning bulb is a circle of bulb_radius_m joined to the road's edges by kerb returns of bulb_return_m (Silverton, OR: a 25 ft curb radius), never under bulb_return_min_m, only where the circle clears the carriageway by bulb_clear_m and the road goes on bulb_tail_m past its mouth (bulb.ts). A footway's back is squared, both edges running on until they meet, in a corner of square_min_deg to 180 less that, its point within square_reach_m of both mouths (derive.ts SQUARE_MIN, SQUARE_REACH).

likeness._doc: How alike two buildings look (sim/buildings/likeness.cpp), by eye: another form adds form_apart, another roof roof_apart, storeys apart by storeys_span or more storeys_apart (less in proportion), colours a colour_span of the three 8-bit channels apart a whole one; a neighbour LOOK_REACH_M off adds distance_weight; a volume is read in columns columns across, in the front row within front_row_m, spanning the body past whole_share of its width.
